senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; preced.) release, rest, esp. cancellation of debts, and rest of the soil, in the Sabbatical year.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 2b:17">M. Kat. 2ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 36a:14">Gitt. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>שְׁמִיטַּת קרקע</he> the rest of the soil; <he>שמיטת כספים</he> the cancelling of cash debts.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 111:6">Sifré Deut. 111</cite> <he>הש׳ שאין נוהג וכ׳</he> (sub. <he>דבר</he>) the law of the Sabbatical year which applies only to Palestine.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 111:10">Ib.</cite> <he>בא״י שאת עושה ש׳</he> in Palestine where you observe the Sabbatical year.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 112:4">Ib. 112</cite> <he>ש׳ משמטת מלוה וכ׳</he> the Sabbatical year causes cancellation of debts, but the year of the jubilee does not; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:9">Ab. V, 9</cite> <he>על שמיטת הארץ וכ׳</he> (Mish. ed. <cite ref="E00931"><he>הַשְׁמָטַת</he></cite>) for the neglect of the laws concerning land in the Sabbatical year and in the year of the jubilee; <cite ref="Shabbat 33a:5">Sabb. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>השמטת שמטין וכ׳</he>.—Pl. <he>שְׁמִטּוֹת</he>, <he>שְׁמִטִּים</he>, <he>שְׁמִטִּין</he>, <cite ref="U01459"><he>שְׁמִיטּ׳</he></cite>. M. Kat. l. c.; Gitt. l. c. <he>בשתי ש׳ וכ׳</he> the text (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 15:2">Deut. XV, 2</cite>) speaks of two releases, the release of the land &c., v. supra.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:1">R. Hash. I, 1</cite> <he>באחד … ר״ה לשנים לש׳ וכ׳</he> the first of Tishri is the New Year for years, for Sabbatical years, and for jubilees.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 85:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXXV</cite> <he>אם … ועשו את הש׳ וכ׳</he> if they give forth the tithes, and observe the Sabbatical years &c.
<cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 38">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXVIII</cite>, v. <cite ref="U01453"><he>שָׁמַט</he></cite>; a. fr.
